title: {{NAME}} and the Princess Who Played to Win
moral: Do your best and never give up, no matter what.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a gold soccer jersey with a small crown badge, purple soccer shorts, golden soccer cleats, and white socks — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} arrived at a wide royal soccer field.
The grass was bright and very green.
Horses and lambs watched from the fence.
A girl in a pink and gold jersey kicked a ball.
It was Princess Nora. She never missed a shot.

pages.content:
Princess Nora ran up to {{NAME}}.
"Will you play against me?" she asked.
"I need a real challenge."
{{NAME}}'s eyes lit up bright.
"I will try my very best," he said.

pages.content:
They kicked and ran and dribbled fast.
The horses cheered with loud neighs.
The lambs baaed every time someone scored.
{{NAME}} fell down once on the wet grass.
He got back up and ran even harder.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} lined up for the last kick.
His heart beat very fast.
He breathed in. He breathed out.
Kick! The ball flew into the corner of the net.
"Amazing!" shouted Princess Nora.

pages.content:
Princess Nora shook {{NAME}}'s hand warmly.
"You never gave up," she said. "That is the best."
The lambs ran onto the field to celebrate.
The horses watched with soft, kind eyes.
{{NAME}} sat in the cool grass and felt very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow Princess Nora wants to teach you her secret move.
